Rihanna's Gown Exhibition Opens at China National Silk Museum

An exhibition titled 'Guo Pei's Garden of Ethereal Realms' has opened at the China National Silk Museum, featuring Rihanna's Golden Dragon Gown. The exhibition showcases the work of designer Guo Pei.
